subject: Russian dissident artist Semyon Skrepezki murdered in Poland
posts: A voice silenced by five bullets in a quiet Polish town. The murder of Semyon Skrepezki exposes the reach of state-sponsored intimidation. Evidence: Political dissent, Targeted execution, State-level terror. #Aletheia #HumanRights 🌐

Semyon Skrepezki, a Russian artist in exile, was shot dead in Biala Podlaska. The method and weapon caliber mirror previous assassinations of Russian dissidents abroad.
